// Defensive KQL: find sensitivity-labeled files sent to external recipients.
let SensitiveFiles = DeviceFileEvents
| where isnotempty(SensitivityLabel)
| project SHA256;
let Mail =
EmailAttachmentInfo
| project SHA256, RecipientEmailAddress, RecipientDomain;
SensitiveFiles
| join kind=inner (Mail) on SHA256
| where RecipientDomain != "internal.example"
